name: @pi-tray/cli
description: The server, the supervisor and package manager in one executable, so they share one copy of Node.js

scripts.package: node ../../scripts/fetch-bundled-packages.mjs && pnpm build && node ../../scripts/package-exe.mjs --entry dist/index.js --name pi-tray --description "Pi-Tray CLI/background service" --icon ../editor/src-tauri/icons/icon.ico
